description: Initial cross-layer prevention rules for AI-generated Skyrim mod builds.

detection.algorithm: Load output with xEdit and a typed parser; enumerate unresolved FormLinks and missing masters; report selected and parsed denominators.

fix_policy.algorithm: Resolve the intended FormKey/master without renumbering unrelated forms.
postconditions: typed parser resolves every non-null FormLink

evidence.notes: Validated for inclusion in the core Agent OS prevention pack on 2026-09-24.

detection.algorithm: Read TES4 light flag/header and every new-form local ObjectID; validate against the target header/runtime range.

fix_policy.algorithm: Compact/recreate only when project policy permits; otherwise change plugin kind.
postconditions: external FormID-dependent artifacts are migrated or proven unaffected

evidence.notes: Validated for inclusion in the core Agent OS prevention pack on 2026-09-24.

rules.title: NPC record and FaceGen winners disagree

detection.algorithm: Join the winning NPC_ appearance record to winning FaceGeom and FaceTint files in the VFS and compare intended appearance provenance.

fix_policy.algorithm: Forward one coherent appearance source and matching FaceGen, or deliberately regenerate from the final NPC record.

evidence.notes: Validated for inclusion in the core Agent OS prevention pack on 2026-09-24.

detection.algorithm: Compare VMAD script/property metadata with pinned PSC/PEX declarations and inheritance; find stale, incompatible or required-unfilled properties.

fix_policy.algorithm: Update bindings or restore a compatible script schema; handle existing-save migration separately.

evidence.notes: Validated for inclusion in the core Agent OS prevention pack on 2026-09-24.

detection.algorithm: Map used native declarations to provider DLLs and compare against effective SKSE layer and load logs.
false_positive_exclusions: optional integrations guarded by provider detection

fix_policy.algorithm: Install/build the correct provider or remove/guard the optional native call.

evidence.notes: Validated for inclusion in the core Agent OS prevention pack on 2026-09-24.

rules.title: Armor, ArmorAddon and NIF slots disagree

detection.algorithm: Compare ARMO body mask, linked ARMA masks/races, and NIF skin partitions for every generated armor variant.

fix_policy.algorithm: Reconcile the intended numeric slot mask and regenerate affected mesh outputs.

evidence.notes: Validated for inclusion in the core Agent OS prevention pack on 2026-09-24.

detection.algorithm: Parse winning NIF shader paths and resolve every required texture through the effective VFS/BSA asset set.
false_positive_exclusions: unused shader slots for the active shader type

fix_policy.algorithm: Correct the path or stage the intended asset.

evidence.notes: Validated for inclusion in the core Agent OS prevention pack on 2026-09-24.

detection.algorithm: Scan touched NAVM records for the Deleted record flag and report cell/worldspace plus override chain.

fix_policy.algorithm: Repair through a navmesh-safe CK/xEdit workflow; do not apply ordinary UDR logic.

evidence.notes: Validated for inclusion in the core Agent OS prevention pack on 2026-09-24.

rules.title: Skyrim SE cell water-flow data reverted

detection.algorithm: Compare water/flow fields in exterior CELL overrides against Update.esm or the selected water-overhaul truth source while ignoring unrelated fields.
false_positive_exclusions: project declares a complete replacement water model

fix_policy.algorithm: Forward only the intended water/flow fields from the chosen truth source.

evidence.notes: Validated for inclusion in the core Agent OS prevention pack on 2026-09-24.

detection.algorithm: Derive expected voice asset identity from final INFO/plugin/VoiceType/response and resolve packaged FUZ/XWM/LIP assets.

fix_policy.algorithm: Regenerate/package voice output from the final dialogue identity.

evidence.notes: Validated for inclusion in the core Agent OS prevention pack on 2026-09-24.

detection.algorithm: Compare recorded input hashes, settings and load-order epoch against current dependency graph.
false_positive_exclusions: frozen vendor artifact not generated by this project

fix_policy.algorithm: Remove only stale generated staging output, rerun its generator, validate, then rebuild downstream dependents.

evidence.notes: Validated for inclusion in the core Agent OS prevention pack on 2026-09-24.

detection.algorithm: Compare active executable/SKSE/Address Library against DLL metadata, dependencies and startup log.
false_positive_exclusions: optional integration disabled on this runtime

fix_policy.algorithm: Install/build the correct runtime binary or narrow the supported runtime matrix.

evidence.notes: Validated for inclusion in the core Agent OS prevention pack on 2026-09-24.

rules.title: Runtime state diverges from static winner

detection.algorithm: Compare static winner with runtime-patcher configs/logs, save/ExtraData state and a live query; construct the final provenance chain.

fix_policy.algorithm: Patch/configure the actual owning layer and document the runtime provenance.

evidence.notes: Validated for inclusion in the core Agent OS prevention pack on 2026-09-24.

rules.title: Validator processed less input than expected

detection.algorithm: Compare independently discovered input count with processed, skipped and errored counts; require every difference to be classified.
false_positive_exclusions: documented scope filter applied before both denominator and numerator

fix_policy.algorithm: Invalidate the result, repair discovery/parser coverage or emit explicit unsupported/skipped items, then rerun.
postconditions: processed plus classified skipped equals discovered

evidence.notes: Validated for inclusion in the core Agent OS prevention pack on 2026-09-24.
